description: Subaree di immersione materiali di dragaggio dei porti is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by arpae.it. Internal subdivision of sea areas where dredged sludge is discharged into regional ports. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Sub-areas of dredging materials of ports" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1999-03-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
